newsitem.title: TURKEY: Istanbul gold volume jumps, prices firm.
newsitem.headline: Istanbul gold volume jumps, prices firm.

text.p: Istanbul gold exchange volume leapt to 1,860 kilos on Tuesday, from Monday's 1,051 kilos as banks engaged in arbitrage and traders took up positions amid expectations of firmer prices, dealers said.
Gold closed firmer at $352.00 an ounce and 1,436,000 lira per gram against $351.00 and 1,430,500 lira on Monday, following European trends.
"Most of the trade was due to arbitrage by the banks, but there was also some activity on the market in the afternoon by buyers expecting firmer prices in the days to come," one dealer said.
The Turkish lira eased to 126,735 lira to the dollar, from 126,670 on Monday, helping the banks' arbitrage deals.
Of the day's trade, 865 kilos changed hands in the morning session and 995 kilos in the afternoon - 50.3 percent of trade was conducted in dollar terms.
